Indian Pilots' Association Requests Flight Suspension to Middle East

The Airline Pilots' Association has formally requested the suspension of all Indian flights to the Middle East. The appeal was directed towards the Civil Aviation Ministry and the Directorate General of Civil Aviation (DGCA). This action comes amid ongoing concerns that necessitate a halt in air travel to the region.
